physical_scope: One symmetric private fixture, both hands; production physics settings from checkpoint 369250 args. Body age 24 months, native joint/tendon ranges, armature/damping, fatigue/body-function modulation retained. Caregiver, visible toys and gaze motion excluded. No learned policy was evaluated and no learned or production state was modified.

definitions.flexion_error: Absolute angle from the requested bending-joint angle, averaged across 28 joints for whole-hand stages or the selected finger only for individual stages.
definitions.other_finger_change: Absolute angle change of bending joints in the other fingers of the SAME hand. This includes intentional anatomical coupling at the knuckles.
definitions.straight: Zero bend angle. Some full-extension limits are negative, beyond straight.
definitions.curl: 95% of each bending joint positive limit, after a one-second target ramp.
definitions.samples: 17 two-second stages and 10 six-second stages; each arm of a comparison restores its private starting state. The six-second and two-second batteries have different conditioning durations.

declaration.scope: Private physical command tests; no learner, reward or production writes.
declaration.target_method: Joint poses converted to world targets at each model step using the current wrist; targets ramp over one simulated second and pass through the live smoother and latch.
declaration.measures: Angle error is absolute requested minus achieved. Individuation reports other-finger movement, including the actual coupling tendons. Straight is zero flexion; extension limit may be negative. No finger-range threshold counts as a learned ability.

target_conflicts.scope: Kinematic candidate only; no learner or production write. Limits and coupling tendons enforced. Collision-free execution and reachability of the wrist itself are separate physical tests, required before adoption.
target_conflicts.method: Closest hand pose by combined world orientation and position error, with position weight 8 radians/metre matching the decoder. Build all finger world targets from this hand pose relative to the commanded wrist. No learned weights or checkpoint fields change.
